title: Winter Protection Plan Missed-Installment Share Schedule
content:
# Winter Protection Plan Missed-Installment Share Schedule

**Schedule.** When a defaulted Winter Protection Plan of the Payment Arrangement program is reinstated, the winter missed-installment share is:

| Missed-installment entries posted on the winter plan within the 6 months before the request | Winter missed-installment share |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 12% |
| Exactly two | 8% |
| Fewer than two | 0 |

The entries counted are the winter plan's own missed-installment entries. A window of 6 months before the request covers entries dated after the same calendar day 6 months earlier, up to and including the request date; entries dated earlier have aged out of the window and do not count.

## Boundary readings (hypothetical request dated February 3)

| Missed entries dated | Count inside the window (after August 3) | Share |
|---|---|---|
| August 3, November 6, December 8 | 2 | 8% |
| September 2, November 6, December 8 | 3 | 12% |
| June 30, July 30 | 0 | 0 |
